then.text: Take the map and good luck. There's a crab in the Baths who knows more than he lets on.

else.text: Treasure map? There's one in the till. Drawn by a customer after four rum punches. I think it's real. It shows a pub.
Welcome to the pub. We pour Navy-style rum here, which is a nod to the tot. That ended on Black Tot Day, 31 July 1970. The grief hasn't.
A customer says he found a map in the toilets. Another says it's a hoax. Ask the park warden at the Baths. Then come back and I'll tell you where I put the actual one.

bvi_sailor.text: Rum ration, the tot: half a pint of rum, daily, to every sailor, until 1970. It was called 'splicing the mainbrace' when you were given extra. The navy's last tot was on Black Tot Day.
I was there when the last one was poured. The sea went quiet.
